data.body:
## LIVE VALIDATION SATISFIED — Codex connects and serves rebar MCP tools

Operator confirms a Codex session now loads the rebar MCP server successfully.

**What actually fixed it — two independent defects, both required.**

1. **The credential (this ticket).** The config named `REBAR_CODEX_PAT`, a variable that appears
   NOWHERE in this repository, and no PAT was present in the environment under either name. Now:
   `bearer_token_env_var = "MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX"` (the canonical name, matching
   `docs/mcp-client-setup.md` and the committed example), with the value persisted from
   `/rebar/prod/mcp-client-pat-codex` so it survives the shell it was set in — the transient
   `export` being the original root cause. `rebar doctor` reports `codex [ok]`.

2. **Cold-start latency (`dewy-rotatable-tarsier`, separate bug).** With the credential fixed,
   Codex still failed at the 30s default because the FIRST `initialize` after a redeploy is slow.
   Measured: >60s immediately post-deploy, then 8.4s, then 0.25s on successive calls.
   `startup_timeout_sec = 120` tolerates it.

**A misdiagnosis of mine, corrected on the record.** I first attributed the timeout to the
blue-green CUTOVER orphaning sessions. Wrong mechanism. The deploy correlation was real but the
cause is cold-start warming, and the discriminator is that three consecutive `initialize` calls
go slow-then-fast — a cutover would fail regardless of order. I compounded it by setting
`startup_timeout_sec`, seeing it work, concluding 'the timeout was irrelevant', and REMOVING it —
which re-broke Codex. The setting was the mitigation, not a diagnostic.

**One safety correction made mid-fix.** I briefly set the URL to the documented `/mcp/` form,
which at that moment still 307-redirected to plaintext `http://`. Reverted to `/mcp` (clean 401)
until the edge fix was deployed. That fix is now live, so both forms are safe.

Also worth noting the diagnostic this ticket produced did its job on the OTHER clients: it flagged
literal PATs embedded in `~/.claude.json` and `~/.copilot/mcp-config.json`, both since migrated to
`${VAR}` references. Those PATs should still be rotated — one was printed into a session
transcript.
